title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: NewVue Health has completed the initial provisioning of a Microsoft 365 tenant to support its transition toward hybrid cloud services. The tenant uses Microsoft 365 Business Premium and the initial cloud domain newvuehealth.onmicrosoft.com. The global administrator account has already been created and can access the Microsoft 365 administration environment. Before the organization proceeds to cloud identity, hybrid identity, and device management tasks, the system administrator must confirm administrative access, identify the correct portals, review the tenant environment, configure company branding, and validate that the new sign-in experience is visible to users.

activities.title: Task 1 - Confirm Administrative Access
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to confirm that the newly provisioned tenant is accessible and ready for administrative review.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Sign in using the administrator account
Confirm that the tenant dashboard loads successfully
answer: Sign in using the administrator account
Confirm that the tenant dashboard loads successfully
activities.explanation: Administrative access must be confirmed before the tenant can be used for later cloud configuration tasks.

activities.title: Task 2 - Identify Portal Responsibilities
activities.prompt:
Matching Task
You want to identify which administrative portal should be used for each management function.
To answer, match each portal on the left with the correct responsibility on the right.
activities.explanation: Each portal has a distinct administrative scope in the Microsoft cloud environment.

activities.title: Task 3 - Navigate to Intune
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to access the Intune admin center from the Microsoft 365 admin center so you can confirm device-management readiness.
To answer, select the appropriate action from the list.
options: Open Admin centers and select Endpoint Manager / Intune
Open Billing and select Your products
Open Users and select Active users
activities.answer: Open Admin centers and select Endpoint Manager / Intune
activities.explanation: The Intune administrative interface is accessed from the Admin centers area of the Microsoft 365 admin center.

activities.title: Task 4 - Verify Subscription Status
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to verify that the tenant is licensed correctly before continuing with additional cloud configuration.
To answer, select the administrative area where this verification is performed.
activities.explanation: Subscription and licensing status is reviewed under Billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

activities.title: Task 5 - Confirm the Initial Cloud Domain
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to confirm the initial domain assigned during tenant creation.
To answer, select the value that represents the default cloud domain in this case study.
activities.explanation: The default Microsoft 365 tenant domain uses the onmicrosoft.com naming format.

activities.title: Task 6 - Complete the Branding Workflow
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to configure the organization’s sign-in branding from the Company Branding page.
To answer, move the appropriate branding stages from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The branding workflow proceeds through staged configuration and ends with review.

activities.title: Task 7 - Validate Branding Changes
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to verify that the new sign-in branding is visible to users after the configuration is saved.
To answer, select the best validation method.
options: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
Create a new Azure virtual machine
activities.answer: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
activities.explanation: A private browser session reduces cached sign-in artifacts and gives a cleaner validation of the updated branding experience.

activities.title: Task 8 - Review Tenant Identity Details
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to review tenant identity information such as the tenant name, tenant ID, primary domain, and license from the identity portal.
To answer, select the page that should be opened first.
activities.explanation: The Overview page in Microsoft Entra is where tenant-level identity details are reviewed.
